children: Peru's economy expanded 3.56% in July compared to the same month last year, data from the nation's INEI statistics agency showed on Tuesday, topping expectations.
July's data landed above the 2.45% growth predicted by analysts polled by Reuters, and picked up speed from the 1.75% expansion registered in June.
